issues.description: The problem statement UML declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() as returning int, while the template's TODO comment and the solution implementation use a double return type. This inconsistency can confuse students about the expected return type and lead them to implement the method with an int (following the UML) whereas the provided solution and likely automated tests expect a double. That may cause type/signature mismatches or failing tests.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the return type consistent across all artifacts. Preferred resolution: update the problem statement UML and descriptive text to indicate getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double (to match the template comment and solution implementation). Alternatively, if an integer result is intended, change the template comment and the solution implementation to return int. Ensure the UML, template comments/signatures, and solution use the same return type and update any tests/documentation accordingly.
